successors.name: Republic of Venice
successors.text: the islands taken in the 1000 campaign (Korcula, Lastovo)

ledger.x: c. 830: the Narentines appear as a seafaring power; Venice attacked their islands in 839 and made peace with Drosaico.
1000: 9 May, Pietro II Orseolo conquers Korcula and razes Lastovo; Narentine power ends.
1000: the Narentines are finally defeated; they vanish from sources by the 11th century.

certainty.note: No frontier on the page; start year approximate.
